name: Mountaintop Mausoleum

assets.label: Arcane Reagents
assets.description: Components for spellcasting and ritual work — rare, perishable, and always in demand.

notes: Mountaintop Mausoleum (Complex, Confinement, Mountain). Perched on a windswept peak, this ancient stone structure was built to imprison something—or someone—of terrible power, but the spirits of its former guards now haunt its corridors, their anguished wails warning away trespassers. The mausoleum's thick walls pulse with residual arcane energy that draws practitioners of magic seeking rare reagents, though few who enter leave without encountering the restless echoes that guard the vaults within.
